name: vLLM
native_tools: --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser <family parser> (the profile's parsers.vllm), plus --reasoning-parser where the family has one.
kv_cache: auto (the model dtype); --kv-cache-dtype fp8 halves it with little loss on recent GPUs.
cache: Automatic prefix caching (on by default in the V1 engine; --enable-prefix-caching on older versions).
notes: Parser names change between releases (for example deepseek_v3 vs deepseek_v31): vllm serve --help lists the ones your version has.
